dossier_meta.statement_text: Let $r\geq 2s-1\geq 3$ be integers. What is the minimum number of edges in an $r$-vertex $s$-uniform intersecting hypergraph with cover number equal to $s$?
dossier_meta.context_text: One of several open questions posed by the authors in Section 4, concerned with the behaviour of $f(n,r,s)$ and/or $g(n,r,s)$.
